content: विमुच् €6 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To free, liberate. .²2 To loosen, unbind, unfasten, untie; ततो विमुक्त्वा सशरं शरासनम् <ls>Rām. 6. 111. 124</ls>; आसीद्विवृत्तवदना च विमोचयन्ती (वल्कलम्) <ls>Ś. 2. 13</ls>. .²3 To give up, lay aside, abandon, quit; विमुच्य रोषं रिपुनिग्रहात्ततः <ls>Rām. 6. 111. 124</ls>; विमुच्य वासांसि गुरूणि सांप्रतम् <ls>Ṛs. 1. 7</ls>. .²4 To let go, let loose; <ls>Bk. 7. 50</ls>. .²5 To except, set aside, set apart; ननु मां कामवधे विमुञ्चता <ls>Ku. 4. 31</ls>. .²6 To shed, pour down (tears); चिरमश्रूणि विमुच्य राघवः <ls>R. 8. 25</ls>. .²7 To throw, cast. .²8 To take off (clothes), undress oneself. .²9 To stop, cease. .²10 To take, assume; समाविशति संसृष्टस्तदा मूर्ति विमुञ्चति <ls>Ms. 1. 56</ls>. .²11 To utter (a sound). .²12 To lay (eggs). --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be deprived of, be freed from. .²2 To drop, be expelled (as a foetus).
